rules_for_ai: Never import @prisma/client or @/lib/prisma inside React Views or UI Components.
Never write fetch() calls directly inside React Views; always consume Services via Hooks.
Keep business logic strictly inside modules/[modulo]/logic as pure TypeScript functions.
Enforce module isolation: only import from a module's public index.ts file.
Respect max line limits per file (Views: 250, Logic: 150, Repositories: 200, Components: 120).
